items.title: Run custom kernels on Intel NPUs
items.oneliner: This repo runs custom C kernels on Intel NPUs and exposes them to Python on Meteor Lake Windows systems.

items.title: Tile macOS windows without disabling SIP
items.oneliner: A macOS tiling window manager with BSP layouts, hot reload, multi-display support, and no System Integrity Protection hacks.

items.title: Enable Resizable BAR on unsupported UEFI
items.oneliner: UEFI driver that unlocks Resizable BAR on unsupported boards, improving GPU memory access for cards like Intel Arc.

items.title: Patch a critical WordPress traversal bug
items.oneliner: Security advisory with affected versions, exploit conditions, and fixed releases for a 9.2 CVSS WordPress path traversal.

items.title: Self-host behind CGNAT with WireGuard
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide for exposing home services behind CGNAT using a VPS, WireGuard tunnels, and private routing.

items.title: Add sandboxing with minimal effort
items.oneliner: Practical walkthrough for locking down apps with containers and cross-platform sandboxing APIs across Linux, macOS, and BSD.

items.title: Benchmark typed decision models reproducibly
items.oneliner: A live benchmark comparing 52 Jev-style systems on intelligence, calibration, speed, and cost with public tasks.

items.title: Check GitHub Actions for secret leaks
items.oneliner: Rust's advisory explains how Miri cache artifacts can expose CI secrets and shows concrete mitigation steps.

items.title: Build Jev locally in Python
items.oneliner: A 25-line Python walkthrough shows how to run a local GGUF classifier for legit, spam, and phishing emails.

items.title: Try Z80 assembly in your browser
items.oneliner: Browser REPL for writing and executing Z80 assembly with instant feedback, useful for learning and quick experiments.
